name: Meeting intent
description: Detect booking, rescheduling and time proposals in replies.
use_when: In reply handling, before a calendar tool is called.

wants_to_book.instructions: The sender wants to book or agrees to a meeting

proposes_a_time.instructions: The sender proposes a specific day or time

wants_to_reschedule.instructions: The sender wants to move or cancel an existing meeting

time_is_firm.instructions: The sender sounds certain about the time rather than tentative
